module "In_Header.dss"
include "Shared.dsh"

product 0 Material "M_Header" backend=Graph
  %0 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L8:C30 "Opacity"
  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(2), ParameterName="SharedGain", SortPriority=0) : float @L4:C1 in "Shared.dsh" "SharedGain"
  %2 = Multiply(%0, %1) : float @L8:C12 in "Shared.dsh" via L8:C17 "Opacity"
  %3 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%2) @L6:C1
  sink %3
